Sligo Bay Lodge, Rosses Point, Co. Sligo

BrochureContent.Content:
Waterfront period home in a premium location

Sligo Bay Lodge is a substantial period-style residence that earns its name. Positioned at Rosses Point on the edge of Sligo Bay, the house commands a panorama that takes in open water, the outline of Coney Island, and the layered silhouette of the surrounding hills — a view that shifts with the light throughout the day and the seasons. With approximately 2,968 sq ft (275.7 sq m) of well-considered accommodation arranged over three floors, this is a home that has been carefully maintained and thoughtfully upgraded over time, without losing any of the character that gives it its appeal.

The entrance lobby sets the tone, drawing you through into a well-proportioned hall from which the accommodation flows naturally. The living room is the heart of the house — a generous, light-filled room with sea views that make it as suited to quiet evenings as it is to hosting. The sitting room offers a secondary reception space with its own outlook over the water, whilst the kitchen and dining area is well laid out for everyday living, with a utility room providing additional practical storage alongside a boiler house.

The 5 bedrooms are distributed across the first and seconds floors, with every room benefiting from sea views. Bedroom 2 is particularly impressive at and the principal bedroom and Bedroom 5 are both well-proportioned rooms with a real sense of space and light. Four of the five bedrooms are en suite, making the house equally well suited to a large family or to those who entertain guests regularly or indeed run a business from the home. A balcony off the landing adds an outdoor element to the upper accommodation - ideal for sitting out and watching the tide come and go. 

Sligo Bay Lodge is available for immediate occupation. It is a home that has clearly been cared for, and one that is ready to be enjoyed from the moment of handover. Whether as a permanent family residence, a west-of-Ireland retreat, or a base from which to explore everything the wider Sligo coastline and countryside has to offer.

Viewing
Strictly by private appointment with the sole agents Savills Country Agency

Fixtures & Fittings
All fixtures and fittings are excluded from the sale including garden statuary, light fittings, and other removable fittings, although some items may be available by separate negotiation. 

Services
Mains water, mains electricity, fibre broadband. 

Please be advised that the selling agents have not checked the services and any purchaser should satisfy themselves with the availability and adequacy of all services. 

Offers
Offers may be submitted to the joint selling agents:
Savills, 33 Molesworth Street, Dublin 2. 

Wayleaves and Rights of Access 
The property will be sold with the benefit of all existing wayleave rights, including rights of access and rights of way, whether public or private. The purchaser will be held to have satisfied themselves as to the nature of all such rights and others.

• Period home with views over Coney Island and Atlantic Ocean
  • Minutes walk from one of the finest golf courses in the country
  • Spacious and well kept home with obvious income potential
  • Private rear garden
  • Close to Sligo Town and Knock Airport
